answer: Stop sybils with zero-knowledge ID attestation: each agent proves it holds one government ID without ever revealing it. To join, an agent (1) scans its ID and passes a face check, (2) mints a proof that the ID is unique, (3) binds the proof to one key, and (4) loses the identity if the same ID appears twice. Faking 10,000 agents needs 10,000 stolen IDs at $120 each, about $1.2 million, plus 10,000 live faces, while one honest agent pays $3. Like an opal that hides its fire until light strikes it, the proof shows truth without showing the secret — no fable of privacy loss, no ivory tower.
